primary_math_proof: The sum of all four separate ribbon perimeters is unchanged. Joining removes both copies of each contact length: P_union=P_separate-2*S. Contact sums are first35+60+85=180, second60+60+35=155. Therefore P_second-P_first=2*(180-155)=50cm, B. Counting each contact only once gives25cm, C, the frozen wrong hypothesis. Source heights, overlaps, interfaces, all outer edges and four ribbons stay fixed.
